mapper.sql: FROM v_bill_financial_summary v JOIN property_unit pu ON pu.property_unit_id = v.property_unit_id JOIN building_unit bu ON bu.building_unit_id = pu.building_unit_id JOIN building b ON b.building_id = bu.building_id JOIN community c ON c.community_id = b.community_id

WHERE 1 = 1 AND c.community_id IN #{scopeId} AND 1 = 0 AND c.community_id = #{query.communityId} AND v.billing_year = #{query.year} AND v.billing_month = #{query.month} AND v.status = #{query.status} AND (pu.property_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.propertyKeyword}, '%') OR c.community_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.propertyKeyword}, '%'))
mapper.select: SELECT v.bill_id, v.bill_no, pu.property_no, c.community_name, CONCAT(c.community_name, ' · ', b.building_no, '号楼 · ', COALESCE(bu.unit_name, CONCAT(bu.unit_no, '单元')), ' · ', pu.property_no) AS full_location, v.billing_year, v.billing_month, v.receivable_amount, v.received_amount, v.outstanding_amount, v.due_date, v.status ORDER BY v.billing_year DESC, v.billing_month DESC, v.bill_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT v.bill_id, v.bill_no, pu.property_no, c.community_name, CONCAT(b.building_no, '号楼') AS building_name, COALESCE(bu.unit_name, CONCAT(bu.unit_no, '单元')) AS unit_name, v.billing_year, v.billing_month, bill.issued_at, v.receivable_amount, v.received_amount, v.outstanding_amount, v.due_date, v.status JOIN bill ON bill.bill_id = v.bill_id WHERE v.bill_id = #{billId}

SELECT bi.item_no, ft.fee_name, ft.billing_method, ft.unit_name, bi.quantity, bi.unit_price, bi.amount, prev.reading_value AS previous_reading, curr.reading_value AS current_reading, bi.note FROM bill_item bi JOIN fee_standard fs ON fs.fee_standard_id = bi.fee_standard_id JOIN fee_type ft ON ft.fee_type_id = fs.fee_type_id LEFT JOIN meter_reading prev ON prev.meter_reading_id = bi.previous_reading_id LEFT JOIN meter_reading curr ON curr.meter_reading_id = bi.current_reading_id WHERE bi.bill_id = #{billId} ORDER BY bi.item_no

SELECT pay.payment_no, p.full_name AS payer_name, pay.amount, pay.paid_at, pay.payment_method, pay.status FROM payment pay JOIN person p ON p.person_id = pay.payer_person_id WHERE pay.bill_id = #{billId} ORDER BY pay.paid_at DESC, pay.payment_id DESC
